title: Dog Grooming
excerpt: Gentle, stress-free grooming that leaves your dog looking and feeling their best — from a quick tidy to a full spa day.
intro: The Stylish Dog is Take The Lead's dedicated grooming service — calm, caring grooming at a pace your dog is comfortable with. Bath, brush, nails, ears and full breed-standard styling, all delivered with patience and plenty of fuss so grooming day becomes something to look forward to.
highlights: Nail trim, ear clean & sanitary tidy
